name: Adlicio
description:
Adlicio turns public customer language into ad and marketing research inside Claude. Search Reddit by topic, scrape comments or reviews from supported public URLs across Reddit, YouTube, Amazon, app stores, review sites, forums, social platforms, and ecommerce marketplaces, then rank the pains, objections, desires, hooks, and verbatim quotes that repeat. You can also research public competitor ads and high-performing short-form videos, search product listings, reuse saved research, and store finished scripts in an Adlicio brand workspace.

Every user connects their own Adlicio account through OAuth. Free and Pro plans include metered Reddit access; All Access unlocks the complete source and workspace toolset. Adlicio returns source URLs and structured data so users can verify the evidence behind each insight.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adlicio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adlicio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tryadlicio.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adlicio MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adlicio lists 16 MCP tools, including create_brand, find_competitor_ads, find_products, find_scroll_stoppers, get_brand_research, get_deep_scrape, get_history_item, list_history, research_topic, save_script, scrape_url, and search_history.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adlicio?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adlicio in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Adlicio requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adlicio is developed by Adlicio. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
